caption:
KYLE LOWRY 🎮🏀 The greatest Raptor ever?

• 2012: traded to Toronto from Houston
• Franchise leader in assists, steals and threes
• 6 straight All-Star games
• 2019: NBA champion
• July 7, 2026: a one-day contract to retire a Raptor
• His No. 7 is going to the rafters

Greatest Raptor ever? 👇
